startTiles.description: The number of tiles populated on a new board. Range: 1 to 8.

fourProbability.description: The percentage chance of spawning a 4 instead of a 2 on new tile generation. Range: 0 to 80 (representing 0% to 80%).

targetValue.description: The score required on a single tile to trigger a win/level complete. Allowed values: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096.
